Embedded PE at 0x5060 has StormAttack DNS-module banner and STORM command-format fingerprint, but lacks executable sections and has a zero-filled entrypoint at RVA 0x741a. It cannot substantiate live DDoS behavior in its present form.
Outer Authenticode content digest mismatches the appended Microsoft certificate; signer text is not Microsoft provenance.
